title: Fernbank Museum of Natural History

services.name: Indoor Exhibits
services.desc: An elevated walkway takes you from the museum’s Terrace into the treetops where you can enjoy stunning views looking out over Wildwoods. From there, you can tailor your experience. WildWoods is open year-round, rain or shine, but may be closed due to inclement weather. WildWoods is suitable for all ages and all fitness levels. It includes ADA-accessible trails and experiences. Fernbank has several volunteer opportunities to assist with restoration projects in our outdoor areas. Questions regarding WildWoods and Fernbank Forest, including forest restoration and volunteer opportunities and internships, should be directed to

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Discover the World of WOW in a new, more personal way! You can now enhance your Fernbank visit with a private program or tour, in which a Fernbank educator will provide an individualized experience to your small group of up to 15 people. Enjoy a private presentation or demonstration from a Fernbank educator for your family or group. Programs are designed for ages 4 and over and parties of up to 15 people. Programs run approximately 15-20 minutes, with time for questions and discussion. Reservation Policies: Program reservations must be made at least one week in advance. Payment is due in full at the time of reservation. Admission must be purchased at the time of reservation. Group rates
